blocking_rules.confirmed_s0: any confirmed S0 caps the grade at weak reject
blocking_rules.confirmed_core_s1: any confirmed S1 in M/S/P/C caps the grade at weak reject
blocking_rules.unfixed_other_s1: an unfixed confirmed S1 outside M/S/P/C caps the grade at borderline
blocking_rules.failed_gate: a failed deterministic gate caps the grade at weak reject unless the adjudicator records inapplicability
blocking_rules.accept_requires: no confirmed S0/S1, all gates green, traceability complete, limitation disclosures present
blocking_rules.calibration: recall < 0.6 or a confirmed rejected Phase-A lead marks the run uncalibrated and refuses to grade
blocking_rules.max_cycles: at most 5 audit cycles, then BLOCKED for human direction

strong reject.description: reopen P0 tasks from the findings; new audit cycle after fixes

reject.description: reopen P0 tasks from the findings; new audit cycle after fixes

weak reject.description: fix all S0/S1 and the S2s named as blocking; re-audit

borderline.description: fix all S0/S1 and the S2s named as blocking; re-audit

weak accept.description: fix the feasible fixes (all S0/S1 + blocking S2); re-audit unless purely editorial

accept.description: if the report lists no blocking fixes → DONE (human sign-off); otherwise fix and re-audit

strong accept.description: if the report lists no blocking fixes → DONE (human sign-off); otherwise fix and re-audit
